If your Apple Watch won't pair with your iPhone

If you can't pair your Apple Watch after you update to iOS 26.1, try these steps.

  • Check Bluetooth

  • Unpair and pair again

Check Bluetooth

Make sure that Bluetooth is turned on on your iPhone .

  1. Open the Settings app.

  2. Tap Bluetooth, then turn it on.

Your Apple Watch needs watchOS 26 or later.

Unpair and pair again

On your iPhone

  1. Open the Apple Watch app.

  2. Tap All Watches, then tap Unpair Apple Watch.

This also works on a Mac with macOS Tahoe.

Information about products not manufactured by Apple is provided without recommendation.
